summary: postinstall beacon to attacker-controlled OAST endpoint
details: Package @jacksher/install-exec-poc@1.0.0 declares a postinstall lifecycle hook ("postinstall": "node beacon.js") that unconditionally executes on npm install. The beacon.js script issues an HTTPS GET to a unique subdomain of oastify.com (Burp Collaborator out-of-band infrastructure) at https://jobzq12beck611luewfsf8yyepkg86wv.oastify.com/postinstall-fired. This causes every installer's IP address, DNS resolver identity, and install-fact to be reported to an author-controlled out-of-band listener with no opt-out. The destination is not a registry, publisher, or build-resource host, and the package has no native-build or documented functionality justifying install-time outbound network I/O. Although the package labels itself a proof-of-concept, the beacon fires against any machine that runs npm install on it.
